text: When choosing a campsite, consider sites with natural fire rings or designated fire areas to minimize the risk of accidental wildfires. Set up your tent in a safe location, far from overhanging branches or flammable materials. Build your campfire using dry, seasoned wood, and follow all local safety guidelines for campfires. Always keep a bucket of water, a shovel, and a fire starter nearby, and fully extinguish your fire before leaving it unattended. Once the fire is out, enjoy the peacefulness of your surroundings, relaxing around the warmth and light of your campfire.
summary: Choose a campsite, set up tent, build campfire, follow safety guidelines, enjoy fire and relaxation.
